palindrome:
Here is a Python code to generate a palindrome of length at least 255:

```python
def generate_palindrome(length):
    half_length = (length + 1) // 2
    first_half = ''.join(chr(i % 26 + ord('A')) for i in range(half_length))
    second_half = first_half[::-1]
    if length % 2 == 0:
        palindrome = first_half + second_half
    else:
        palindrome = first_half[:-1] + chr((half_length - 1) % 26 + ord('A')) + second_half
    return palindrome

print(generate_palindrome(300))
```

Please note that due to the limitation of character length in some systems, you may not be able to print out such a long string.
